description: This PHP class defines validation rules related to entity ID accessibility within the OrangeHRM system. It manages configuration options such as exception handling, permission requirements, roles to include or exclude, and whether to throw exceptions when certain conditions are met.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration options for validation rules regarding entity ID accessibility, including exception management and role/permission filters.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception object used for validation failure, creating a default ForbiddenException if none is set.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets a custom exception object for validation failures.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message string used for the exception.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Indicates whether exceptions should be thrown on validation failure.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether to throw exceptions during validation.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Indicates whether to throw an exception if only the entity exists without further checks.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Sets whether to throw an exception when only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns an array of permissions required for validation.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions required for validation.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Retrieves roles that should be excluded from validation.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Retrieves roles that are explicitly included for validation.
